title: Verify the whole-work-order Add dialog opens from the WO toolbar more (⋯) menu at Whole Work Order scope

preconditions: 1. You are logged in as a role that has Work Orders: Create & Edit and See Financial Data.

steps: 1. Click the ⋯ (More actions) menu at the top-right of the work order toolbar.

expected: 1. A dialog opens with the title 'New Fee / Discount' (spec S2-R9). In the current design mockup the header reads 'Add new fee/discount' with the WO number (e.g. 'S2-13274') as the context subtitle.

5. In the 'Amount' field enter 100 (shown with a $ prefix).

7. Click the confirm button ('Add Fee' per spec / 'Add' in the design mockup).

title: Verify the live preview computes and displays a whole-WO percentage discount (8% of $10,715.39 → −$857.23)

preconditions: 1. Logged in with Work Orders: Create & Edit + See Financial Data.

steps: 1. Open 'Add Work Order Fee / Discount' from the ⋯ menu.
2. Set Type = 'Discount'.
3. Set Calculation type = 'Percentage'.
4. In the Amount field enter 8 (shown with a '%' suffix).
5. Read the live preview block.
expected: 1. Preview row 'Work Order Total' shows $10,715.39.
2. Preview row label flips to 'Discount' and shows −$857.23 (8% × 10,715.39 = 857.2312, rounded to nearest cent = 857.23; §5-R3).
3. Preview row 'New Work Order Total' shows $9,858.16.
4. The bottom of the preview reads 'Tax is recalculated on save.' (S2-R35).

notes: Design↔spec: the design preview always computes a percentage against the single flat WO Total and has NO base selector, whereas spec §5-R4 says whole-WO % must resolve against Net Labor / Net Parts / Subtotal depending on method. This is requirements open question #1. On staging, confirm which base is actually used; the −$857.23 number here matches the design's single-total math.

title: Verify the Add button is disabled until Name, Type, Calculation type and Amount>0 are all set

5. Enter Amount = 0; observe.
6. Change Amount to 25; observe.
expected: 1. With all fields blank, the Add button is disabled.

title: Verify Max Amount (Max cap) caps a percentage adjustment (20% fee on $100 → +$15 with Max $15)

expected: 1. The raw computed fee is $20.00 (20% × $100).

title: Verify removing an adjustment uses 'Create and Edit', NOT the 'Delete' permission
permissions_required: Work Orders: Create & Edit ON, Delete OFF (whole-WO) + See Financial Data + flag ON
preconditions: 1. Logged in as a role that HAS Work Orders: Create & Edit and See Financial Data but does NOT have the separate 'Delete' permission.
2. An open work order with a whole-WO adjustment.
steps: 1. Hover the whole-WO adjustment entry on the sidebar card and open its ⋯ menu.
2. Confirm a remove/delete option is present and usable.
3. Remove the adjustment.
expected: 1. The remove option is available and works despite the user lacking the separate 'Delete' permission (S13-R7).
2. The adjustment is removed successfully.
3. (Contrast) A user WITHOUT Create & Edit sees no remove control and the action is rejected (S13-N2).
viu_status: Pending — verify on staging once deployed
notes: Key permission nuance: 'Delete' permission is for whole records (WO, labor line, part); removing an adjustment is part of 'Create and Edit' (S13-R7). For a line/part adjustment the required permission is Work Order Lines: Create & Edit (S13-R4).

title: Verify multiple adjustments on one part each resolve on the part's own base (do not compound) and net correctly
permissions_required: Work Order Lines: Create & Edit + See Financial Data + flag ON
preconditions: 1. Logged in with Work Order Lines: Create & Edit + See Financial Data.
2. An open work order with a part of gross part total exactly $100.00.
steps: 1. Add a Part Line discount: '% of Parts Total' 10%.
2. Add a second Part Line discount: '% of Parts Total' 5%.
3. Add a Part Line fee: Flat Amount $2.00 (part quantity = 1).
4. Open the part's breakdown modal and read each amount and the Net adjustment.
expected: 1. The 10% discount resolves against the part's gross $100.00 → −$10.00 (NOT against the already-discounted amount; line-level adjustments do not stack, §5-R5 Step 1).
2. The 5% discount also resolves against $100.00 → −$5.00.
3. The Flat Amount fee resolves to +$2.00 ($2.00 × qty 1).
5. On the Lines tab only the first adjustment shows with a 'Show 2 more' toggle (S3-R15).
design_ref: part inline stacking + Show N more (§2b); breakdown Net adjustment (§8)
viu_status: Pending — verify on staging once deployed
notes: Critical calc rule: line-level percentages all resolve against the same gross base — they never compound on each other (§5-R5).

title: Verify two whole-WO percentage adjustments resolve against the same net totals and do not change each other's base
permissions_required: Work Orders: Create & Edit + Work Order Lines: Create & Edit + See Financial Data + flag ON
preconditions: 1. Logged in with Work Orders: Create & Edit, Work Order Lines: Create & Edit, and See Financial Data.
2. An open work order with Gross Labor $200.00 and Gross Parts $100.00, no shop supplies.
3. A Labor Line 10% discount already applied (Step 1: −$20.00, so Net Labor = $180.00).
steps: 1. Add a whole-WO fee '% of Labor Total' 5%.
2. Add a whole-WO discount '% of Parts Total' 10%.
3. Read each resolved amount.
expected: 1. The Labor Line discount resolved first: 10% × $200.00 = −$20.00, Net Labor = $180.00 (Step 1, §5-R5).
2. The whole-WO 5% fee (% of Labor Total) = 5% × $180.00 = +$9.00 (uses Net Labor from Step 1).
3. The whole-WO 10% discount (% of Parts Total) = 10% × $100.00 = −$10.00.
4. The two Step-2 whole-WO adjustments do NOT change each other's base (§5-R5 worked example).
design_ref: sidebar card lists multiple whole-WO adjustments (§1a); Stats/Financial totals (§1b, §3)
viu_status: Pending — verify on staging once deployed
notes: Uses the spec's own §5 worked example. Confirms three-step resolve order and no compounding between whole-WO adjustments.

story_ref: Overview 'apply same template more than once' / §3 key decisions
title: Verify the same template can be applied to one work order more than once by hand
permissions_required: Work Orders: Create & Edit + See Financial Data + flag ON
preconditions: 1. Logged in with Work Orders: Create & Edit + See Financial Data.
2. An open work order; the location library has a 'Parts Handling Fee' template.
steps: 1. Open 'Add Work Order Fee / Discount', apply the 'Parts Handling Fee' template, and Save.
2. Repeat: open the dialog again, apply the same 'Parts Handling Fee' template, and Save.
3. Inspect the sidebar card and the Financial Info 'Fees & Discounts (N)' count.
expected: 1. Both adjustments are added; the same template appears twice as two independent adjustments (§3 key decision: same template may be applied more than once by hand).
2. The count and totals reflect both instances.
viu_status: Pending — verify on staging once deployed
notes: This is intentional manual re-application, distinct from the auto-apply + customer-default DOUBLE-ADD bug (requirements open question #4), which is a known defect, not a spec requirement.
